name: 文章の三択問題
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset: ONE existing Lighthouse component LH05-0003 文章の三択問題.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: Image1 is the ORIGINAL source screenshot and controls choice-control anatomy, subtle bottom lip, geometry/proportions, alignment, spacing, optical weight and fine details. Image2 is our secondary Japanese mock for existing translated content and component bounds. Image3 is approved Lighthouse style only. Correct crude mock details according to the ORIGINAL; never import unrelated full-screen content.
Render exactly three full-width rounded choice buttons stacked vertically, as one compact white component. At390px logical width use16px side margins, buttons358px wide and48px high,12px vertical gaps. Original subtle bottom edge/depth should remain restrained and precise. First two choices unselected, third selected. Keep selection as selection, not success/correctness.
Exact text centered on separate buttons in this order: “本”, “クロワッサン”, “ワイン”.
Locked typography: Meiryo Regular14px/24px, tracking0, centered; no bold. Pure #FFFFFF background and white unselected buttons with fine #E4E4E4 outlines and ink #1D1D1D.
Evidence-based accent choice: Original source uses blue only to show selected third answer. Retain that meaningful selected-state accent, instead of copying our mock's broad mint replacement. Selected third button gets a very light azure #E7F5FC fill, clear coherent blue #339AC3 outline/text and a small darker bottom edge, matching the original selected control anatomy. Selected fill is local to this control, not page tint. Do not add arbitrary colored icons.
There is no primary submit CTA inside this component; do not add a forest-green check button or change selection into a green success state. Official forest-green brand gradients are for actual primary actions elsewhere.
Keep compact readable alignment and source rounded-control proportions. No heading, question illustration, avatar, progress, checkmark, radio dot, extra button, status bar, logo, watermark or footer. All visible text Japanese as specified. Output this single component tightly framed; no device frame.
reviewNotes: Original source controls fine anatomy; mock secondary Japanese content. Inspected full original, comparison crop, mock, native fields and output. All three Japanese labels correct, third selection retained in coherent local blue like original, no invented success mark or CTA. White unselected surfaces and restrained original bottom lip retained. No artwork in assigned component. Exact native font metrics and interaction not established. Agent visual review only, no owner approval/editability/app implementation.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
